name: otelcol.exporter.googlecloud

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: GCP project identifier.

arguments.name: destination_project_quota
arguments.description: Counts quota for traces and metrics against the project to which the data is sent as opposed to the project associated with the Collector’s service account. For example, when setting project_id or using multi-project export.

arguments.name: user_agent
arguments.description: Override the user agent string sent on requests to Cloud Monitoring (currently only applies to metrics). Specify {{version}} to include the application version number.

exported_fields.name: input
exported_fields.description: A value other components can use to send telemetry data to.

destination_project_quota.description: Counts quota for traces and metrics against the project to which the data is sent as opposed to the project associated with the Collector’s service account. For example, when setting project_id or using multi-project export.

user_agent.description: Override the user agent string sent on requests to Cloud Monitoring (currently only applies to metrics). Specify {{version}} to include the application version number.

debug_metrics.description: Configures the metrics that this component generates to monitor its state.

arguments.name: target_principal
arguments.description: TargetPrincipal is the email address of the service account to impersonate.

arguments.name: delegates
arguments.description: Delegates are the service account email addresses in a delegation chain. Each service account must be granted roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the next service account in the chain.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.description: Subject is the sub field of a JWT. This field should only be set if you need to impersonate as a user. This feature is useful when using domain wide delegation.

log.description: Configuration for sending logs to Cloud Logging.

arguments.name: compression
arguments.description: Compression format for Log gRPC requests. Supported values: [gzip].

arguments.name: default_log_name
arguments.description: Defines a default name for log entries. If left unset, and a log entry doesn’t have the gcp.log_name attribute set, the exporter returns an error processing that entry.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.description: Endpoint where log data is sent.

arguments.name: error_reporting_type
arguments.description: Enables automatically parsing error logs to a JSON payload containing the type value for GCP Error Reporting.

arguments.name: grpc_pool_size
arguments.description: Sets the size of the connection pool in the GCP client.

arguments.name: resource_filters
arguments.description: If provided, resource attributes matching any filter is included in log labels. Can be defined by prefix, regex, or prefix AND regex. Each object must contain one of prefix or regex or both.

arguments.name: resource_filters > prefix
arguments.description: Match resource keys by prefix.

arguments.name: resource_filters > regex
arguments.description: Match resource keys by regular expression.

arguments.name: service_resource_labels
arguments.description: If true, the exporter copies the OTel service.name, service.namespace, and service.instance.id resource attributes into the GCM timeseries metric labels.

arguments.name: use_insecure
arguments.description: If true, disables gRPC client transport security. Only has effect if Endpoint isn’t "".

arguments.name: attribute_mappings
arguments.description: Determines how to map from OpenTelemetry attribute keys to Google Cloud Trace keys. By default, it changes HTTP and service keys so that they appear more prominently in the UI.

arguments.name: attribute_mappings > key
arguments.description: The OpenTelemetry attribute key.

arguments.name: attribute_mappings > replacement
arguments.description: The attribute sent to Google Cloud Trace.
